IP22 or IP2X are typical minimum requirements for the design of electrical accessories for indoor use. [ 2 ] The digits indicate conformity with the conditions summarized in the tables below. The digit 0 is used where no protection is provided. The digit is replaced with the letter X when insufficient data has been gathered to assign a protection level. The device can become less capable; however, it cannot become unsafe. There are no hyphens in a standard IP code. IPX-8 (for example) is thus an invalid IP code.
